jobs.title: Intern, Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quick answer: Qualys Internship 2027 is open in Pune for the Intern, Engineering role (Req R0005182), aimed at BE/BTech students in CS, IT or a related branch who graduate in 2027. Apply by 27 Nov 2026 on the official Qualys Workday portal; the stipend and duration are not disclosed.

Qualys Internship 2027 — job details at a glance Company Qualys Role Intern, Engineering Requisition ID R0005182 Location Pune, Maharashtra (work mode not stated) Eligibility BE/BTech CS, IT or related – 2027 batch (currently pursuing) Experience Students / freshers Stipend Official: Not disclosed | Reported: about ₹41,000/month (Myinternships, one Qualys Pune intern listing) Duration Not stated Posted on 24 Nov 2026 Apply by 27 Nov 2026 (night, IST)

Qualys Internship 2027 – full job details

Qualys Internship 2027 gives engineering students a seat on the team that builds the Qualys cloud security platform in Pune. The listing, titled Intern, Engineering, went live on 24 November 2026, and the Workday portal is set to stop taking applications after 27 November, so the window is only a few days long.

Each intern is paired with a mentor and owns one project from start to finish. The posting also mentions a possible full-time offer at the end, though it does not promise one. Qualys has not published the stipend, internship length, start month or work mode, and we have not filled those gaps with guesses.

2027 batch only: the requisition asks for students currently pursuing BE/BTech who graduate in 2027. Candidates who passed out in 2025 or 2026 do not match this opening.

Short window, missing details: the portal is scheduled to close after 27 Nov 2026. Stipend, duration and joining date are not stated, so ask the recruiter for them in writing if you are shortlisted.

What you will do in the Qualys Internship 2027 role

  • Take a mentored project through design, coding and testing
  • Add and refine features on the Qualys cloud-based security platform
  • Write tidy code backed by unit and integration tests
  • Record your work in documentation and share learnings with the team
  • Try out AI and machine learning ideas for the product and for the way the team builds it

Qualys Internship 2027 eligibility

The Qualys Internship 2027 requisition lists these requirements, summarised in our own words:

  • Pursuing BE/BTech in Computer Science, IT or a related branch, passing out in 2027
  • A solid grip on data structures, algorithms and object-oriented programming
  • Coding ability in Java, Python, C++ or a comparable language
  • Strong problem solving and the habit of asking good questions
  • Basic AI/ML awareness: ML fundamentals, LLMs, or something you built with AI tools or APIs
  • Clear communication and real eagerness to learn

Good to have: SQL or NoSQL basics, REST APIs, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes or any public cloud, plus personal, hackathon, open-source or coursework projects, ideally with an AI angle. Not stated: CGPA cut-off, backlog rule, duration and joining date. Treat any figure you see elsewhere for these as unconfirmed.

Expected stipend: the Qualys Internship 2027 stipend has not been disclosed. A Qualys Pune intern listing on Myinternships (GRC and Compliance intern, 4 months, hybrid) shows about ₹41,000 per month. That is a single data point for a different team, and AmbitionBox and Glassdoor carry no reliable Qualys intern stipend data, so use it as a rough indication and check your offer letter.

Qualys Internship 2027 selection process

Qualys has not published the selection rounds for the Qualys Internship 2027. Based on how product companies usually hire engineering interns, plan for these steps:

  1. Resume shortlisting against the job description
  2. Online coding test on DSA and core computer science
  3. One or two technical interviews on DSA, OOP, your projects and basic AI/ML
  4. HR or manager discussion on stipend, start date and availability

These are typical rounds for a Qualys Internship 2027 applicant, not confirmed ones. Watch your email and the Workday candidate inbox for the real schedule.

How to apply for Qualys Internship 2027

  1. Open the official Qualys Intern, Engineering listing (R0005182)
  2. Click Apply and sign in or create a Workday account
  3. Upload your resume and enter 2027 as your graduation year
  4. Answer the screening questions and submit before 27 Nov 2026 night (IST)
  5. Save the confirmation email and track your status in the Workday candidate home

About Qualys

Qualys is a cloud security and compliance company founded in 1999 and headquartered in Foster City, California. Its cloud platform covers vulnerability management, asset inventory, policy compliance and web application security for enterprises around the world, and the company runs a large engineering centre in Pune. Official site: qualys.com.
